why: ramp-v1 with Hypnotic Siren kept. v1 cut it as a weak {U} body and that ONE card was holding blue`s requirement down: with it gone the {U}{U} spells (Counterspell, Muddle the Mixture, Fear of Impostors) defined the blue pip profile, blue`s source target jumped 22 -> 36 and blue on-curve COLLAPSED 89.5% -> 61% -- worse than the black problem this whole line of work started from. A cheap single-pip card is load-bearing for a colour requirement in a way nothing about the card itself suggests. Three white cuts for three rocks; blue is untouched.
